_about: Pipeline site list. Fields id, name, lat, lon, description, psr_distance_km and nasa_avg_illumination_pct follow docs/CONTRATO_DE_DADOS.md (sites.json). The other fields record provenance. Coordinates are regional reference points, NOT NASA-designated landing sites. lat/lon: degrees, MOON_ME (DE421 mean Earth/polar axis), east-positive longitude in [-180, 180).

sites.name: Shackleton rim
sites.description: Regional reference point on the Shackleton crater rim crest, derived from the LOLA 20 m DEM inside the NASA region 'Shackleton Rim' (Site04). Not a NASA-designated landing site.

source.document: Derived by this project (docs/DECISOES.md D20) from: NASA M2M-30044 Moon to Mars Lunar Surface Data Book (2025), Table A2.1-1, region 'R04 or Site04 Shackleton Rim' centre (-89.7668, -171.87); region bounds = PGDA product 78 tile Site04; heights = PGDA product 90 LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ (20 m).
source.location: Rule: nearest pixel to the published centre, inside the Site04 tile, that is the highest point within 250 m and higher than the centre (pipeline/sites/crest_point.py; python -m pipeline.sites.derive_crest_point)

sites.cross_check: Height 1738.4 m (centre 770.9 m), 1919.6 m from the published centre, local slope 3.6 deg (centre: 31.4 deg).

sites.name: Connecting ridge
sites.description: Regional reference point: point CR1/C1 on the Shackleton - de Gerlache connecting ridge used in NASA Lunar Surface Data Book traverse examples. Not a NASA-designated landing site.

source.document: NASA ACD-50044 Lunar Surface Data Book, Initial Release, effective 2022-10-06
source.location: Page 26 of 43, figure caption (HEOMD-410 Example 6), and page 32 of 43, section 7.3.3; repeated in M2M-30044 (2025), figure 7.3.2.7-1, page 54 of 93

sites.cross_check: Published as 222.6° E (0-360); stored here as 222.6 - 360 = -137.4. About 150 m from the Site01 region centre (-89.4632, -137.49) in Table A2.1-1 of M2M-30044 (pipeline/sites/verify_site_points.py).

sites.name: de Gerlache rim

source.document: NASA M2M-30044 Moon to Mars Lunar Surface Data Book, Baseline, effective 2025-03-18 (NASA/TP-20250002845)
source.location: Appendix A2.1, Table A2.1-1 Lunar South Pole Features, page 75 of 93
source.quote: R11 or Site11 de Gerlache Rim 1 -88.6834 -67.9321

sites.cross_check: Matches the centre of PGDA product 78 Site11_final_adj_5mpp_surf.tif. Site11 is the region the PGDA product 78 README names 'de Gerlache rim'.

sites.name: Shackleton inner wall (Site04 center)
sites.description: Published centre of the LOLA 5 m DEM region 'Shackleton Rim' (Site04). It lies on the crater's inner wall (~31 deg slope), so it is kept only to show how sensitive light and Earth visibility are to the exact position. Not a NASA-designated landing site.
